planCriteria.criterion: Given a client is logged in, when they submit a document request with an attached file, then the request is created in the system with a 'Pending' status.
Given a client is logged in, when they view their dashboard, then they can see a list of all their submitted document requests and their current statuses.
Given a lawyer is logged in, when they select a pending document request, then they can update the status to 'In Progress' or 'Completed'.
